source: TMLR/arXiv revision package accompanying manuscript commit b0314a0
scope: Additive offline reproduction tools; experimental algorithms and recorded measurements are unchanged.

adjustments.analyze_campaign.py: Load runtime modules from the repository root and default campaign inputs to reproduce/artifacts/data/campaign; permit output under reproduce/output. Disable bytecode generation so imported archived objectives remain read-only.
adjustments.analyze_objective0.py: Default data inputs to reproduce/artifacts/data and baseline source to repository root; report missing input and protect archived inputs.
adjustments.restore_design_figure.py: Default data inputs to reproduce/artifacts/data/figuredata/figure_data and output to reproduce/output/figure3.pdf; use public author metadata.
adjustments.requirements-historical.txt: Unchanged recorded dependency versions, kept separate from active runtime requirements.
adjustments.requirements.txt: NumPy, SciPy, and Matplotlib subset of release/core/requirements-analysis.txt; the only scientific dependencies used by these offline tools.
